name: Ravenous Fire
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Components: V,S,F (a piece of brimstone and a small amount of blood)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Target(s): One primary target plus one secondary target/level (each must be within 30 ft. of the primary target)

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

Ravenous fire is identical to chain lightning, except it deals fire damage instead of electrical damage.
